dct_title_s: Plan for the connection of Cedar Lake and Brownie Lake, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan for the connection of Cedar Lake and Brownie Lake in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-third Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 36.
